description: VO is a podcast app that remembers what you heard. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to the VO account you sign in with: the episodes you played and the exact words you heard in them, the moments you saved with a double tap while listening, and your listening notes: the personal recap VO writes and emails you when you finish an episode, built around your moments and its key points. Ask what a guest said, get the gist of an episode with what you heard and what you still have to catch up on, recap a week of listening, or find the moment you half remember, and every answer links to vo.fm at the exact second. It can also search VO's public podcast catalog. It cannot play, add, change, or delete anything.

defaultPrompt: What did I listen to recently?
